costs.stress_2x: same signals and execution replayed with 2.0x fee/slippage

execution.position_sizing: fixed maximum loss including entry and stop fees plus adverse stop slippage

implementation_equivalence.reason: Original all-clock in-memory implementation exceeded runtime memory during the 576-clock build.
implementation_equivalence.replacement: memory-bounded one-clock feature generation plus vectorized exact execution
implementation_equivalence.reused_run_evidence: original run recorded real BTC event equivalence across costs/equities

information_boundaries: One-minute bars become usable only after close.
Five-minute signals use exactly five completed one-minute bars and enter no earlier than the next one-minute open.
Dollar-volume event bars use a threshold based only on the prior 20 completed UTC days; current-day volume never affects its own threshold.
Source one-minute bars are indivisible and feature/trade paths crossing a gap are invalid.
Funding cashflow uses the historical settlement rate at its recorded timestamp; contract one-minute open is a disclosed mark proxy.
objective: Find a causal, realistically costed, one-global-slot BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP strategy or portfolio with at least 1% geometric daily NAV growth and non-concentrated repeatable expectancy.

DOLLAR_BAR_ABSORPTION_V2.bar_threshold: median prior 20 completed UTC daily quote volumes / target bars per day
